steelman.ac: AC1: Original Workday contract identifier is stored on the amendment transaction (the amendment Order/record that syncs to Workday).
steelman.argument: Steelmanning Marc's "completed" claim, the strongest good-faith case runs like this: the amendment Quotes DO carry usable original-contract lineage. For 4 of the 6 amend orders, Quote.Original_Order_Id__c points at the original order, and that original order's Workday_Contract_ID__c equals its own Id -- so the Workday contract to amend IS discoverably present in Salesforce, and MuleSoft could read it to target the right contract. One could argue the "identifier is stored" (on the Quote lineage) and only the last-mile Mule mapping is pending. However, this does not survive scrutiny against the AC as written ("stored on the amendment TRANSACTION"): (1) On the amendment Order itself, every candidate carrier is either self-referential or empty -- Workday_Contract_ID__c == the order's OWN Id on all 6/6 orders, and the standard OriginalOrderId AND Source_Order_Id__c are NULL on all 6/6, so the Order carries no pointer to the prior contract at all. (2) The two synced payloads (00095512, 00095642) were re-pulled fresh and deep-walked: every identity key -- sfContractId, orderId, fortraSfdcExternalId, contractReferenceId -- equals the amendment's own Id, customerContractType='Master_Contract', and there is NO original/prior/parent/amended/alternate key anywhere in the JSON. (3) The Quote.Original_Order_Id__c lineage lives on the Quote (not the transaction), is never emitted into any stored payload, and is NULL for 2/6 native/manual amendments (00095531, 00095676; Quote_Type__c null). (4) No new field, picklist value, flow, or Apex artifact exists in any org: Workday_Contract_Type__c = ['Master_Contract'] only across all 4 sandboxes (empty via Prod describe), Marc's only fields created in the last 10 days are Quote.Renewal_Quote_Stale__c (boolean) and Contract.Renewal_Opportunity__c (ref->Opportunity) -- both renewal, neither an original-Workday-contract carrier -- and no recently-modified Apex/flow builds the payload or injects an original-contract reference. (5) Git has zero history for the ticket, no metadata is staged in the working tree, and the independent peer review records Status='To Do (not yet built)' / 'APPROVE INTENT, RETURN FOR DESIGN'. The gap is real but unimplemented; the AC is NOT met.

verdict.rationale: No artifact makes the ORIGINAL Workday contract reference available to Mule for amendment orders. steelman.ac: AC2: The original-contract reference is available to the Permendor/MuleSoft integration/processing (i.e., present in the outbound payload or a field Mule reads).
steelman.argument: The strongest good-faith case for PASS would be: (a) Mule could read Order-level lineage instead of the payload, since standard fields Order.OriginalOrderId and Order.Source_Order_Id__c (reference->Order) exist on the transaction in UAT/fulltemp/Prod and would carry the original order whose Workday_Contract_ID__c == its own Id; and (b) the Workday Submit_Customer_Contract API genuinely supports the reference (it defines Customer_Contract_Reference 'for update only purposes', Original_Customer_Contract_Reference, Alternate_Customer_Contract_Reference, and a Customer_Contract_Amendment_Reference_ID type), so the mechanism to identify the contract-to-amend is available end-to-end; and (c) 4/6 amendment orders share a ContractId with exactly one original sibling order, giving Mule a derivable in-SF path to the original Workday contract Id. However, every leg of this case fails on verification: Order.OriginalOrderId AND Source_Order_Id__c are NULL on all 6 amendment orders; Contract.Original_Contract__c is null on all 6 contracts; the two populated payloads emit only self-referential keys (contractReferenceId/sfContractId/orderId/fortraSfdcExternalId all == the amendment order's OWN Id) with customerContractType=Master_Contract and a static name='Amendment Quote', and NONE of the Workday original/alternate/amendment reference fields are populated; the sibling path is merely derivable (not emitted) and does not exist for 2/6 orders (#00095531, #00095676 are the only order under their contract); and the SC-3516 peer review explicitly records SC-3505 as Status 'To Do (not yet built)'. So no original-contract reference is actually present in the payload or in any field Mule reads today.
evidence: Live FortraUAT re-query of all 6 OriginalActionType=Amend orders: payloadLen 00000656=0, 00095512=1591, 00095531=0, 00095635=0, 00095642=1594, 00095676=0 (4/6 empty); Workday_Contract_Type__c=Master_Contract on all 6.

Exhaustive flatten of both populated payloads: sfContractId=orderId=fortraSfdcExternalId=contractReferenceId all equal the amendment order's OWN Id (801WC00000koIE3YAM / 801WC00000ltUiuYAE); customerContractType=Master_Contract; name='Amendment Quote' (static literal). ZERO keys reference an original/prior/alternate/amend/parent/source contract.

Order.OriginalOrderId AND Order.Source_Order_Id__c are NULL on all 6 amendment orders (sf data query, table output). No Order field carries an original Workday-contract reference; Workday_Contract_ID__c == the order's own Id.

Contract link query: Contract.Original_Contract__c is null on all 6 contracts; Contract has no Workday_Contract_ID__c column. 4/6 amend orders have a sibling original order under the same ContractId (00095512<->00095510, 00000656<->00000655, 00095635<->00095634, 00095642<->00095639); 2/6 (00095531, 00095676) are the only order under their contract.
Workday_Contract_Type__c picklist via describe = [Master_Contract] (active) in FortraUAT and fulltemp; FortraProd exposes an empty picklist (type=string). No Alternate/Amendment/Prior value anywhere.

Submit_Customer_Contract.md (Workday API ref) defines Customer_Contract_Reference ('Reference to an existing Customer Contract for update only purposes'), Original_Customer_Contract_Reference, Alternate_Customer_Contract_Reference, and a Customer_Contract_Amendment_Reference_ID type — the target fields EXIST but the SF/Mule payload populates NONE of them.

verdicts.ac: AC3: Workday can identify which existing contract should be amended (payload carries Original_Customer_Contract_Reference or an Alternate contract type pointing at the original).

verdict.ac: AC3: Workday can identify which existing contract should be amended (payload carries Original_Customer_Contract_Reference or an Alternate contract type pointing at the original).
verdict.rationale: No artifact carries or emits the original Workday contract reference for amendments. I independently re-queried all 6 UAT amendment orders (OriginalActionType=Amend) and dumped the JSON of the only 2 populated Workday_Sync_Payload__c payloads. In BOTH, every contract-identity key (contractReferenceId, sfContractId, orderId, fortraSfdcExternalId) equals the amendment order's OWN Id — there is NO Original_Customer_Contract_Reference, no prior/alternate/parent/amended-contract key of any name. customerContractType is Master_Contract in both, and the Workday_Contract_Type__c picklist in UAT exposes only the single active value Master_Contract (no Alternate/Amendment contract type exists to point at the original). The remaining 4/6 amendment orders have EMPTY payloads (Workday_Sync_Status__c=Pending), so they carry nothing at all. On the repo side, no .cls or .flow-meta.xml emits customerContractType/contractReferenceId or any Original_Customer_Contract_Reference into the payload; the only grep hit (Fortra_Quote_to_Order_Conversion flow, element Set_Amendment_Contract_Defaults) merely links the amendment Order to a Salesforce Contract via internal vars (varCreatedContractId = Quote.Renewal_Contract__c) and does not stamp any Workday contract reference or alternate type. Because the payload gives Workday only the amendment order's own Id and a Master_Contract type, Workday CANNOT identify which existing contract to amend from the transaction. Requirement is unmet.
evidence: Live FortraUAT re-query (read-only sf data query) of the 6 Amend orders: 00095512 (801WC00000koIE3YAM) SyncStatus=Success payload_len=1591; 00095642 (801WC00000ltUiuYAE) SyncStatus=Success payload_len=1594; 00000656, 00095531, 00095635, 00095676 all SyncStatus=Pending payload_len=0 (EMPTY).

Parsed keys of BOTH populated payloads: contractReferenceId == sfContractId == orderId == fortraSfdcExternalId == the amendment order's OWN Id (801WC00000koIE3YAM / 801WC00000ltUiuYAE). No Original_Customer_Contract_Reference / prior / alternate / parent / amended-contract key present. name='Amendment Quote' (free text, no id). customerContractType='Master_Contract'.
Order.Workday_Contract_Type__c picklist in FortraUAT describes as exactly one active value: Master_Contract. No Alternate/Amendment/Prior value exists to designate an original contract.

Repo grep across force-app/ for Original_Customer_Contract_Reference|originalContractReference|Alternate.?Contract|priorContract|Original.?Workday.?Contract => no emitting artifact. grep for payload keys customerContractType|contractReferenceId in *.cls/*.flow-meta.xml => none.

The sole flow grep hit, force-app/main/default/flows/Fortra_Quote_to_Order_Conversion.flow-meta.xml element Set_Amendment_Contract_Defaults, only assigns internal vars (varContractWasLinked=true, varCreatedContractId=varQuoteRecord.Renewal_Contract__c, varOrderActivationMode) — SF Contract linkage, not a Workday payload/original-contract-reference write.

Consistent with discovery: outbound is platform event Order_Completed_WD__e carrying only Order_Id__c; the payload is built by MuleSoft and written back, and today it carries only self-referencing ids + Master_Contract type.
verdict.whatWouldMakeItPass: The Workday Submit_Customer_Contract payload for amendment orders must include a key that carries the ORIGINAL contract's Workday reference (e.g. Original_Customer_Contract_Reference / amendedContractReferenceId) set to the original order's Id (WCID) — OR customerContractType must be set to an Amendment/Alternate value plus a field pointing at the original contract — such that its value differs from the amendment order's own Id. Concretely: (a) add an Amendment/Alternate value to Workday_Contract_Type__c and/or a dedicated original-Workday-contract field on the amendment Order, (b) populate it from the original order (derivable via Quote.Original_Order_Id__c for 4/6, but the 2 native/manual amendments with null Quote_Type__c/Original_Order_Id__c need a separate source), and (c) have MuleSoft emit that value in the payload. Verification would be the two Success payloads showing an original-contract key whose value != own Id, and all Pending amendments producing non-empty payloads with the same key.

steelman.ac: AC3: Workday can identify which existing contract should be amended (payload carries Original_Customer_Contract_Reference or an Alternate contract type pointing at the original).
steelman.argument: The strongest good-faith case for PASS would rest on either (a) an original-contract reference key inside the amendment Workday_Sync_Payload__c, or (b) an Alternate/Amendment value on Workday_Contract_Type__c pointing at the original contract. I searched for both across all 5 orgs (including fulltemp and FortraProd) and the repo, and neither exists. The only near-miss lineage that Workday could theoretically use is Salesforce-internal (Order.OriginalOrderId, Quote.Original_Order_Id__c, Contract.AmendedContractId/Original_Contract__c) — these DO link an amendment to its original in Salesforce, and for 4/6 amendments the original order's Workday_Contract_ID__c equals its own Id (i.e. the Workday contract to amend is derivable in-SF). But this lineage is (i) never emitted into the Workday payload, (ii) not on the amendment transaction as a Workday-contract reference, (iii) SF Contract/Order lineage rather than a Workday contract identifier, (iv) all predates SC-3505 by months, and (v) absent on the 2 native/manual amendments. So even the steelman derivation is not implemented and cannot satisfy 'payload carries Original_Customer_Contract_Reference or an Alternate contract type pointing at the original.' There is no honest reading under which AC3 is met.
evidence: Live FortraUAT re-query (read-only) of all 6 OriginalActionType=Amend orders: #00095512 (801WC00000koIE3YAM, Success, payload_len=1591) and #00095642 (801WC00000ltUiuYAE, Success, payload_len=1594) both have contractReferenceId == own Order Id and customerContractType=Master_Contract; #00000656, #00095531, #00095635, #00095676 all Sync=Pending with payload_len=0 (empty).
Parsed both populated payloads: NO Original_Customer_Contract_Reference / prior / alternate / parent / amended-contract key of any name; the only order-Id-valued keys equal the amendment's own Id.

Workday_Contract_Type__c picklist across FortraUAT/FortraDP2/MergeBuild/fulltemp = single active/default value Master_Contract; no Alternate/Amendment/Prior value. FortraProd exposes the field as string with no picklist value. No Alternate contract type exists anywhere to point at the original.
fulltemp and FortraProd: zero Amend orders with any Workday_Sync_Payload__c (count with payload = 0 in both) — no freshly-built passing data exists in those orgs.

No dedicated original-Workday-contract field on Order in any of the 5 orgs; the contract/amend/original-named Order fields are ContractId, OriginalOrderId, Workday_Contract_ID__c(=own Id), Workday_Contract_Type__c, etc. — none carries the original contract's Workday reference.

Repo grep across force-app/ and Data/ for customerContractType|contractReferenceId|Original_Customer_Contract|amendedContract|Alternate_Contract|originalContractReference: no emitting .cls or .flow-meta.xml. Only flow hits (Contract_Amendment_CoTermination, Contract_Amendment_CoTerm_Override_Detection) write the STANDARD SF Contract.AmendedContractId field, not a Workday payload reference.

FortraUAT Tooling API: only 1 custom field modified on Order/Contract in last 10 days (Contract.Renewal_Opportunity, 2026-06-24, unrelated); 0 flows modified in last 10 days named workday/amend/contract/original/payload. No SC-3505 artifact.

Consistent with discovery: SF outbound is platform event Order_Completed_WD__e (only Order_Id__c); MuleSoft builds the payload and writes it back; today it carries only self-referencing ids + Master_Contract type.

synth.overall: SC-3505 is NOT implemented in any org under review. Across all four ACs the required artifact — an ORIGINAL Workday contract identifier stored on the amendment transaction and emitted to Workday so it can identify the contract to amend — does not exist. Live read-only re-query of all 6 FortraUAT amendment orders (OriginalActionType=Amend) confirms: only 2 (#00095512 / 801WC00000koIE3YAM, #00095642 / 801WC00000ltUiuYAE) have a populated Order.Workday_Sync_Payload__c; the other 4 are EMPTY (Sync=Pending). In BOTH populated payloads every contract-identity key — contractReferenceId, sfContractId, orderId, fortraSfdcExternalId — equals the amendment order's OWN Id (self-reference), customerContractType='Master_Contract', and name='Amendment Quote' is a static literal. There is ZERO original/prior/alternate/parent/amended-contract key in either payload. Order.Workday_Contract_ID__c == own Order.Id on all 6 (WCID==Id True). Order.OriginalOrderId and Order.Source_Order_Id__c are NULL on all 6; Contract.Original_Contract__c is NULL on all 6 contracts. The Workday_Contract_Type__c picklist exposes only the single active value Master_Contract across all 4 sandboxes (FortraProd describe returns an empty picklist) — no Alternate/Amendment type exists to designate an original. No SF Apex class or flow builds the payload or injects an original-contract reference; grep of force-app/ classes and flows for the payload keys (customerContractType/contractReferenceId) or original-contract terms (Original_Customer_Contract_Reference/originalContractReference/Alternate_Contract) returns no emitting artifact. The outbound is platform event Order_Completed_WD__e carrying only Order_Id__c; MuleSoft builds the Submit_Customer_Contract payload and writes it back. Git has zero history on any branch for 3505/workday-contract/amend/original-contract, no metadata is staged, and the only working-tree material is the SC-3516 peer-review folder itself (PEER_REVIEW_REPORT.md records Status 'To Do (not yet built)' / Disposition 'APPROVE INTENT, RETURN FOR DESIGN'). The steelman for each AC found no pass evidence and did not overturn. Marc's 'completed' claim does not hold: the intent is sound and the gap is real, but nothing has been built. The pre-existing Quote.Original_Order_Id__c (created 2026-01-09, ~6 months before the ticket) is a derivation opportunity only — it lives on the Quote, is never emitted, and is null for the 2 native/manual amendments — so it cannot satisfy 'stored on the amendment transaction.'

perAC.ac: AC1: Original Workday contract identifier is stored on the amendment transaction (the amendment Order/record that syncs to Workday).
perAC.why: No field on the amendment Order carries the original contract's Workday reference. Live FortraUAT re-query of all 6 OriginalActionType=Amend orders: Order.Workday_Contract_ID__c == own Order.Id on all 6 (self-reference, not the prior contract); standard Order.OriginalOrderId and Order.Source_Order_Id__c are NULL on all 6; Contract.Original_Contract__c NULL on all 6. Order describe (222 fields, FortraUAT) shows no purpose-built original-Workday-contract field. No new CustomField created for the ticket (Marc's only last-10-day fields are renewal-scoped: Quote.Renewal_Quote_Stale__c boolean, Contract.Renewal_Opportunity__c ref->Opportunity — neither an original-contract carrier). The only lineage that exists, Quote.Original_Order_Id__c (created 2026-01-09, predates ticket), lives on the Quote not the transaction and is NULL for 2/6 native/manual amendments (#00095531, #00095676; Quote_Type__c null). To PASS: a dedicated field on the amendment Order (e.g. Original_Workday_Contract_ID__c) stamped with the ORIGINAL order's Id, populated for all 6 amendments including the 2 native/manual ones. Steelman found no pass evidence; no overturn.

perAC.ac: AC2: The original-contract reference is available to the Permendor/MuleSoft integration (present in outbound payload or a field Mule reads).
perAC.why: Nothing makes the original reference available to Mule. Of 6 amend orders only 2 have a populated Order.Workday_Sync_Payload__c (#00095512 len=1591, #00095642 len=1594); 4 are EMPTY (Pending). In both populated payloads every identity key (sfContractId/orderId/fortraSfdcExternalId/contractReferenceId) == the amendment order's OWN Id; a keyed scan for original/prior/amend/parent/source/predecessor returned ZERO hits. No Order field distinguishes the contract-to-amend (Workday_Contract_ID__c == own Id). Grep of force-app classes/flows for payload keys or original-contract terms returns no SF injector — the payload is built in MuleSoft; SF outbound = Order_Completed_WD__e with only Order_Id__c. Mule COULD derive the original via Quote.Original_Order_Id__c (4/6) or the shared Order.ContractId sibling (4/6), but this is NOT done today and is unavailable for 2/6 orders. AC2 requires the reference to actually be available/emitted, not merely derivable. To PASS: emit a distinct original-contract key into the amendment payload (value = original order's Id, != own Id) OR stamp a Mule-readable Order field, populated for all 6. Steelman (checked Order.OriginalOrderId/Source_Order_Id__c NULL 6/6, sibling path not emitted, 2/6 no sibling) found no pass evidence; no overturn.

perAC.ac: AC3: Workday can identify which existing contract should be amended (payload carries Original_Customer_Contract_Reference or an Alternate contract type pointing at the original).
perAC.why: The payload gives Workday only the amendment order's own Id and customerContractType='Master_Contract', so Workday cannot identify the contract to amend. Both populated payloads (#00095512=801WC00000koIE3YAM, #00095642=801WC00000ltUiuYAE) have contractReferenceId == own Id and NO Original_Customer_Contract_Reference / prior / alternate / parent / amended key of any name; the other 4 payloads are empty. Workday_Contract_Type__c picklist = single active value Master_Contract across all 4 sandboxes (FortraProd empty picklist) — no Alternate/Amendment type exists to point at the original. The Submit_Customer_Contract API DOES define Original_Customer_Contract_Reference / Alternate_Customer_Contract_Reference / Customer_Contract_Amendment_Reference_ID (per sc3143 API ref), but the payload populates NONE of them. Repo grep finds no emitting artifact; the only flow near-miss (Fortra_Quote_to_Order_Conversion, element Set_Amendment_Contract_Defaults) assigns internal vars (varCreatedContractId = Quote.Renewal_Contract__c) linking an SF Contract, not a Workday reference; Contract_Amendment_CoTermination flows write only standard Contract.AmendedContractId. To PASS: emit Original_Customer_Contract_Reference (or add an Amendment/Alternate Workday_Contract_Type__c value + original-contract field) whose value = the original order's WCID, for all 6 amendments. Steelman found no pass evidence; no overturn.

synth.whereImplementation: NOT IMPLEMENTED ANYWHERE. Orgs checked (all read-only): FortraUAT, FortraDP2, MergeBuild, fulltemp (schema+picklist+live data); FortraProd (schema describe only per rule). No org contains a new field, picklist value, flow, or Apex class purpose-built for SC-3505. SF side: no Apex/flow constructs the Workday payload or injects an original-contract reference (grep of force-app/main/default/classes and /flows returns no emitting artifact); the payload-building flows Fortra_Order_Set_Workday_and_PO_Fields v1/v2 are BOTH Obsolete; Fortra_Order_Workday_Contract_ID (Active) only stamps Order.Workday_Contract_ID__c=$Record.Id. Mule side: MuleSoft builds the Submit_Customer_Contract payload and writes it back to Order.Workday_Sync_Payload__c; the current live payloads (FortraUAT #00095512, #00095642) carry only self-referential ids + customerContractType='Master_Contract' with no original-contract key — so no original reference exists on the Mule side either. Git: zero history on any branch (main, uat) for 3505/workday-contract/amend/original-contract; no metadata staged in the working tree. The ONLY working-tree material referencing the ticket is the review folder 'Jira/PeerReview/sc3516 | Peer Review - SC-3505.../' (PEER_REVIEW_REPORT.md, README.md, JIRA_COMMENT_SC3516.md, VALIDATION_RUNBOOK.md, evidence/) plus read-only payload captures under Data/sc3516/ — review/design commentary, not deployable code. PEER_REVIEW_REPORT.md records SC-3505 Status 'To Do (not yet built)' and Disposition 'APPROVE INTENT, RETURN FOR DESIGN'.
stillRequired: AC1 — Add a dedicated custom field to the amendment Order (e.g. Order.Original_Workday_Contract_ID__c) and stamp it with the ORIGINAL order's Id (= the Workday contract to amend). Derive from Quote.Original_Order_Id__c (works for 4/6) OR the sibling order sharing Order.ContractId; must also cover the 2 native/manual amendments (#00095531 801WC00000ksL59YAE, #00095676 801WC00000mA6TcYAK) where Quote_Type__c and Original_Order_Id__c are null and there is no sibling under the Contract — these need a separate source (e.g. Contract.Original_Contract__c backfill or manual capture).

AC2 — Make the original reference readable by MuleSoft: either populate the new Order field above (Mule reads it) and/or have Mule/SF emit it into Order.Workday_Sync_Payload__c. Must be populated for ALL 6 amendment orders — note 4/6 currently have EMPTY payloads (Sync=Pending), so a re-sync is required after the field is populated.

AC3 — Emit the reference into the Workday Submit_Customer_Contract payload as a distinct original-contract key (Original_Customer_Contract_Reference / Customer_Contract_Amendment_Reference_ID — the API supports these per sc3143 reference) whose value = the original order's WCID (!= the amendment's own Id). AND/OR add an Amendment/Alternate value to the Workday_Contract_Type__c picklist (currently ['Master_Contract'] only in all sandboxes) so customerContractType conveys the amend relationship instead of the static 'Master_Contract'.

Verification/evidence to require from Marc before accepting 'complete': the two Success payloads must show an original-contract key whose value == the original order's Id (not the amendment's own Id), and all 4 Pending amendment orders must re-sync to produce non-empty payloads carrying that same key. Because the payload is MuleSoft-built, coordinate the Mule mapping change with the SF field change — an SF field alone will not reach Workday.

The verdict repeatedly asserts 'MuleSoft builds the Submit_Customer_Contract payload' and that no original-contract key is emitted, but the ONLY evidence for the Mule side is the payload it wrote BACK to Order.Workday_Sync_Payload__c. If Marc's SC-3505 work were done as a Mule DataWeave mapping change (not SF metadata), it would be entirely invisible to every check performed. I confirmed there is no .dwl / mule-artifact / mule-config anywhere under /Users/liamjeong/Documents/Code/Fortra.
gaps.howToClose: Obtain and grep the MuleSoft/Anypoint project repo (separate git repo, not in this SFDX workspace) for the Submit_Customer_Contract transform: search DataWeave for keys Original_Customer_Contract_Reference, Alternate_Customer_Contract_Reference, Customer_Contract_Amendment_Reference_ID, and for any mapping that reads Order.Original_Order_Id__c / ContractId. Also check the Anypoint deployment history for a release dated near the ticket. If the repo is inaccessible, ask Marc directly for the Mule branch/PR. NOTE: the 2 live Success payloads (re-read: #00095512, #00095642) still show every identity key == the amendment order's own Id with NO original key, so even a deployed Mule change has not yet produced a correct payload — but a Mule change that only takes effect on re-sync of the 4 Pending orders could exist and be untested. This is the single largest blind spot.

gaps.gap: Field/picklist visibility via describe reflects only the RUNNING USER's FLS and profile. A field or picklist value gated behind a permission set the running user lacks would be invisible to sf sobject describe. This directly affects the AC1/AC3 'no new field' and 'picklist only Master_Contract' claims.
gaps.howToClose: Largely closed already: I re-verified via the Tooling API CustomField object (which is FLS-INDEPENDENT metadata) that in the last 60 days there are ZERO new Order fields, exactly ONE new Contract field (Renewal_Opportunity, Marc, renewal-scoped) and ONE new Quote field (Renewal_Quote_Stale, Marc, renewal-scoped) — neither an original-contract carrier. So no hidden field exists regardless of FLS. Residual: the Workday_Contract_Type__c picklist values were read via describe (FLS-visible) and could in theory hide an inactive/perm-gated 'Amendment' value; to fully close, query Tooling API StandardValueSet/CustomField metadata or GlobalValueSet for that field's full value set including inactive values. Low risk since describe showed restrictedPicklist=false and a single value.

gaps.gap: FortraProd data was never queried (schema-only rule), so no Prod amendment order or Prod payload was read. If SC-3505 were somehow live only in Prod, the data-level checks (payload self-reference, NULL lineage) would not have caught it.

If Marc's demo used amendment orders identified a different way (e.g., a manual/native amendment with OriginalActionType null, or amendments in a different record type / owned by another user and not visible under the running user's sharing), the population could be undercounted.

gaps.gap: The verdict cites the sc3143 Submit_Customer_Contract API reference as proof that Workday SUPPORTS Original_Customer_Contract_Reference / Alternate_Customer_Contract_Reference / Customer_Contract_Amendment_Reference_ID, but does not confirm the CURRENT Workday tenant/version actually exposes those fields or that Permendor's contract is Workday's native API. If the amend relationship is instead expressed by a mechanism the analysis didn't consider (e.g., matching on an external contract number Workday already holds, or a Workday-side lookup keyed on account+effective-date), then 'no original key in payload' would not by itself prove Workday cannot identify the contract.

This is a design-confirmation, not a build-check; it does not change the finding that nothing new was built, but it strengthens/qualifies the AC3 'Workday cannot identify' assertion. The peer-review folder (PEER_REVIEW_REPORT.md) already reaches 'RETURN FOR DESIGN', consistent with this open design question.
